strings.name: Bono
strings.summary: Born Paul David Hewson, Bono formed the band that became U2 with schoolmates in Dublin. His religious, political and personal lyrics and large-scale performances shaped the group’s influence. Alongside albums including The Joshua Tree, he campaigned on African poverty, debt relief and HIV/AIDS, co-founding ONE and (RED). Memoir, solo theater and film have explored his life while he continues writing with U2.
